government_contract_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

defense_budget_same_theme_winner_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with a mature defense_budget_theme government_space_contract row whose 10d cash-relative PnL, same-theme replacement value, and direct event return are positive
